desc: The Q Boombox 8.6 Blackout is a groundbreaking semi-automatic rifle that brings the raw power and versatility of the 8.6 Blackout cartridge to a fast-cycling, full-featured platform unlike anything else on the market. Chambered in the increasingly popular 8.6 Blackout — a cartridge engineered to deliver devastating subsonic and supersonic performance from an AR-10 compatible platform — the Boombox pairs a 16-inch barrel with a 1:3 twist rate purpose-built to stabilize the long, heavy projectiles that define this cartridge's exceptional terminal performance. The gray Cerakote finish provides durable, weather-resistant protection, while the optics-ready Picatinny rail and threaded 5/8x24 muzzle make it equally at home behind a suppressor or a muzzle brake. Whether running supersonic loads for maximum impact or subsonic rounds through a suppressor for hearing-safe performance, the Q Boombox 8.6 Blackout is a versatile, hard-hitting semi-automatic rifle built to push the boundaries of what a modern sporting rifle can do.
